payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_revert.py::test_the_second_subset_never_changes_what_revert_decides stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/gates/core/revert.py. The claim was "The second subset never changes `revert`'s status, failures or tool, except that a checkout or restore that fails is `error`. The witness takes seven first-run outcomes, and a diff that adds no new test. These are a pass verdict, a fail verdict, an errored run and a run that did not enumerate. They are also failures keyed on something other than a name, a handed name left unaccounted for, and a raised exception. It crosses each with eight second-run outcomes. These are one test passing, all passing, all failing, an errored run and a raised exception. They are also a run that did not enumerate, failures keyed elsewhere and every name uncollected. Each result matches the same call without `locations`, which runs only the first subset. A checkout that fails and a restore that fails each give `error`, with no failures and no tool, with a first subset and without one. A first subset that exemption empties still lets the second subset run. That call runs the second subset alone, matches the call without `locations` and carries the clause.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_revert.py::test_a_collected_name_that_reads_as_an_option_never_reaches_the_runner, tests/test_revert.py::test_a_reverted_run_that_enumerated_nothing_still_passes, tests/test_revert.py::test_the_verdict_is_scoped_to_the_subset_not_the_whole_enumeration, tests/test_revert.py::test_the_tool_is_the_one_that_actually_ran, tests/test_revert.py::test_uncommitted_work_somewhere_else_does_not_stop_the_gate, tests/test_revert.py::test_a_witness_whose_declared_subject_the_diff_changed_is_judged_and_named, tests/test_revert.py::test_an_exempt_new_test_is_left_out_of_the_reverted_run_and_named, tests/test_revert.py::test_a_handed_name_the_reverted_run_does_not_account_for_is_an_error, tests/test_revert.py::test_each_verdict_names_the_tests_the_reverted_run_could_not_collect, tests/test_revert.py::test_one_uncollectable_new_id_leaves_a_verdict_on_the_witness_beside_it, tests/test_revert.py::test_with_no_locations_the_rewritten_tests_are_never_run, tests/test_revert.py::test_a_diff_revert_cannot_read_leaves_the_second_subset_unrun_and_says_so, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
